lines.text: The root is Cept! Accept, concept, except.
Did you know? Cept is Latin for take.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus take?

words.mean: an idea taken together in the mind
words.ex: The concept of time is different in some cultures.
The shop is open every day except Sunday.

publish.title: Cept root: accept, concept and except
publish.value: Cept comes from Latin "capere" (to take, to seize). Words: accept, concept and except. accept = ac + cept; concept = con + cept; except = ex + cept.
